Backend: 28/28 pytest passing (including 2 new logo_size tests). Frontend: sound toggle persists in localStorage, CSV downloads trigger real files (ordenes_2026-05-30.csv, reporte_2026-05-24_2026-05-30.csv), all 4 logo-size selectors present, logo_size=lg saved and persisted in backend. /app/frontend/src/utils/csv.js uses Blob URL approach (URL.createObjectURL) which produced verified downloads in both /orders and /stats flows.
Backend Business model accepts logo_size in PUT /api/business (verified sm/md/lg/xl all persist via GET).
SettingsPage shows logo-size-{sm,md,lg,xl} only when logo preview exists — confirmed behavior.
Minor: stats page emits recharts container size warnings (width=-1) — should add explicit min-h/min-w wrapper.
